title: Pukka Juice Blue Pear Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blue Pear Ice from Pukka Juice seamlessly blends the rich sweetness of Blueberries with the luscious crispness of Pear, all underscored by a cooling icy layer. This e-liquid promises a perfectly balanced, refreshing vape with a complex yet irresistible fruit flavour. 100ml shortfill bottles from Pukka Juice provide a lasting solution for e-liquid aficionados, allowing for extended enjoyment and personalisation of nicotine content. Every bottle is packed with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, complemented by an additional 20ml space designated for a pair of nicotine shots. This gives you the freedom to define your nicotine strength intensity. To achieve 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to the 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and you're all set with your ideal blend. The advantage of shortfills extends beyond the prolonged enjoyment of e-liquids. They represent a cost-effective and convenient alternative to topping up with traditional 10ml bottles. With a higher VG concentration, these e-liquids are optimally designed for powerful sub-ohm vape devices and low-resistance coils, ensuring optimal flavour and vapour output. Enhance your vaping journey by choosing shortfills for extended enjoyment of your go-to e-liquids. Pukka Juice stands out as a premier option when you're seeking standout shortfill e-liquid flavours. Boasting a collection of nearly 20 deliciously distinct flavours across categories like Fruits, Desserts, Drinks, and Confectionary, they set the bar high in terms of quality and pure vaping pleasure.
